item.description:

Perfect if you want an expedition planned around what the ice, weather and wildlife offer each day, with excursions, meals and drinks already included. 🧭

Seven departures run between July 2027 and August 2028, with a hotel night in Oslo and a charter flight to Longyearbyen included. Ideal for couples or friends travelling together who want wildlife, ice and Inuit culture with the logistics handled.
*Fifteen days from Oslo to Reykjavik, from £15,082 per person twin share* 🚢
